en.name: JSON to Table Converter
en.description: Convert a JSON array of objects into a readable table online. This JSON to table converter detects columns automatically, reports row and column counts, flattens nested objects when needed, and exports the data as CSV.

hero.trustHtml: Runs in your browser. Your JSON is not uploaded by this tool.

meta.title: JSON to Table Converter – Free Online JSON Table Viewer
meta.description: Convert JSON to a table online. Paste an array of objects, preview rows and columns, flatten nested objects, and download CSV. Free and runs in your browser.

features.title: Array of Objects to Table
features.description: Turn an array of JSON objects into rows and columns. Each object becomes one row, and the object keys become the table headers.

features.title: Automatic Column Detection
features.description: Columns are collected from every record in the array. When a record does not contain a column, that cell stays empty instead of shifting the row.

features.title: Row and Column Counts
features.description: The preview reports how many rows and columns were detected, so you can confirm the whole array was read before exporting.

features.title: Optional Nested Flattening
features.description: Flatten nested objects into dot-notation columns such as address.city. With flattening off, an object or array value is shown as compact JSON in a single cell.

features.title: CSV Export
features.description: Download the table data as a UTF-8 CSV file with a BOM, ready for Excel, Google Sheets, or other spreadsheet tools.

features.title: Paste or Open a File
features.description: Paste JSON into the editor or open a .json file from your device. Parsing and rendering happen in the browser.

features.title: Browser-Based Processing
features.description: Parsing, column detection, and CSV generation run in your browser. No account and no upload to a conversion server.

guide.title: Enter a JSON array of objects
guide.description: Paste an array such as [{"name":"Alice"},{"name":"Bob"}] or open a .json file. Every item has to be an object, because each item becomes one row.

guide.title: Check the detected columns
guide.description: The table renders as soon as the JSON parses. Read the row and column counts and scan the headers to confirm every field you expect is present.

guide.title: Flatten nested objects when needed
guide.description: Enable Flatten nested objects to turn nested properties into dot-notation columns. Leave it off if you prefer to see nested values as compact JSON in one cell.

guide.title: Download the CSV
guide.description: Click the CSV button to save the table data. Open the file in Excel or Google Sheets to sort, filter, or chart the records.

example.output:
name    age  city
Alice   30   New York
Bob     25   London
example.useCase: Preview an array of API records as a table before exporting it to a spreadsheet.

faq.question: What JSON input does this tool accept?
faq.answer: A top-level JSON array whose items are objects, for example [{"name":"Alice","age":30}]. Arrays of strings, numbers, or arrays are rejected, because every item has to become one row of the table.

faq.question: Can I convert a single JSON object to a table?
faq.answer: No. This page expects an array of records. If your data looks like {"results":[...]}, paste the inner array instead, or use a JSON viewer that is built for object inspection.

faq.question: How are the table columns chosen?
faq.answer: Columns are collected from every object in the array, in the order the keys are first seen. A record that does not contain a column leaves that cell empty.

faq.question: Can I convert nested JSON to a table?
faq.answer: Yes, with limits. Enable Flatten nested objects to turn nested properties into dot-notation columns such as address.city. Nested arrays do not always have a natural two-dimensional shape, so they are either serialized into one cell or need a separate transformation.

faq.question: Can I sort, filter, or paginate the table?
faq.answer: No. The preview is a static table view: it does not offer sorting, filtering, pagination, editing, or column selection. Download the CSV if you need to work with the records in a spreadsheet.

faq.question: How many rows does the preview show?
faq.answer: The preview renders the first 100 rows to keep the page responsive. The reported row count and the CSV export still cover every record in the array.

faq.question: Can I download the table as CSV?
faq.answer: Yes. The CSV export uses UTF-8 with a BOM so Excel recognizes accented and non-Latin characters, and values containing commas, quotation marks, or line breaks are quoted and escaped.

faq.question: Can I convert a large JSON file?
faq.answer: The page does not set a fixed row limit, but everything runs in your browser. Very large arrays depend on your device memory and take longer to parse and render.

faq.question: Does this page generate HTML code?
faq.answer: No. This page is for previewing JSON records as a table and exporting them as CSV. Use the JSON to HTML Table page when you need copyable table markup or a downloadable .html file.

faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: This page parses JSON and builds the table in your browser and does not require an upload to a conversion server. You should still avoid entering passwords, API keys, access tokens, or other highly sensitive information into any browser-based tool.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON to table converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can paste or open JSON, preview the table, and download CSV without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert JSON to a Table
article.content:
What Is a JSON to Table Converter?

A JSON to table converter takes structured JSON records and lays them out as rows and columns so they are easier to read. The input that works best is an array of objects, where each object is one record and each property is one column.

Developers use this view when inspecting an API response, a database export, a log file, or a configuration dump. Reading 200 records as a table is usually faster than scrolling through raw JSON text, and the row and column counts tell you at a glance whether the whole array was read.

Supported JSON Structure

The supported input is a top-level array of objects:

[{"name":"Alice","age":30},{"name":"Bob","age":25}]

Every item in the array has to be an object. An array of strings such as ["a","b"], an array of numbers, or an array of arrays cannot be turned into rows and columns, so it is rejected with an error message. If your document wraps the records in an object such as {"results":[...]}, paste the inner array instead.

How to Convert JSON to a Table

  1. Enter the JSON: Paste an array of objects into the editor or open a .json file.
  2. Read the counts: Check the reported row and column counts to confirm the whole array was parsed.
  3. Scan the headers: Confirm that every field you expect appears as a column and that values line up.
  4. Handle nesting: Enable flattening when nested properties should become their own columns.
  5. Export: Download the CSV and continue in Excel, Google Sheets, or another spreadsheet application.

Automatic Column Detection and Missing Values

Real records rarely share exactly the same keys. A user list may have an optional phone number, an order list may have a refund field only on some rows. The converter collects the keys from every object in the array, in the order they are first seen, and uses that union as the columns.

When a record does not contain a column, the cell stays empty. Row alignment is preserved, but a source array with many optional properties produces a wide table with many empty cells.

Flattening Nested JSON

A flat table works best when every cell holds a scalar value such as a string, number, boolean, or null. Nested objects do not fit into a single cell, so the optional flattening mode rewrites paths as dot-notation columns:

{"user":{"name":"Alice"},"address":{"city":"New York"}}

becomes columns such as user.name and address.city. Nested arrays are harder: they can hold many values or many objects, and there is no single obvious two-dimensional shape for them. With flattening off, an object or array value is shown as compact JSON text inside one cell.

Table Preview, CSV, and HTML Output

The three options solve different problems, and it is worth picking the right one before you start:

  • Table preview: Use it to read and sanity-check the records in the browser.
  • CSV: Use it when the data has to continue into Excel, Google Sheets, a database import, or a reporting pipeline.
  • HTML table: Use it when the result has to be displayed on a web page or pasted into a CMS or documentation editor.
  • Raw JSON: Keep it when nested structure, exact data types, or machine-to-machine exchange must be preserved.

Limits of the Table Preview

The preview is a static view generated from your input. It does not offer sorting, filtering, pagination, editing, or column selection, and it does not include a spreadsheet-style toolbar. The preview also renders only the first 100 rows so the page stays responsive; the reported row count and the CSV export still cover every record.

If you need to sort, filter, chart, or edit the records, download the CSV and continue in a spreadsheet application. If you need markup to embed in a page, use the JSON to HTML Table page instead.

Browser-Based Privacy

This tool is designed to parse JSON and build the table in your browser rather than uploading the input to a remote conversion service. That is useful for internal datasets and development data, but it is not a guarantee of complete security. Avoid entering credentials, access tokens, personal information, or confidential production data into any web-based tool.

faq.answer: 顶层是 JSON 数组、且每一项都是对象，例如 [{"name":"Alice","age":30}]。字符串数组、数字数组、数组的数组都会被拒绝，因为每一项都要变成表格的一行。

faq.question: 可以把单个 JSON 对象转成表格吗？
faq.answer: 不可以。本页面要求输入记录数组。如果数据是 {"results":[...]} 这种结构，请粘贴里面的数组；也可以用专门查看对象的 JSON 浏览器。

faq.question: 表格的列是怎么确定的？
faq.answer: 列会从数组中的每一个对象里收集，按键首次出现的顺序排列。某条记录没有这个字段时，对应单元格留空。

faq.question: 支持嵌套 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 支持，但有边界。启用“展平嵌套对象”后，嵌套属性会变成 address.city 这样的点号列。嵌套数组不一定有天然的二维形态，所以要么被序列化到一个单元格里，要么需要另外的转换处理。

faq.question: 可以排序、筛选或分页吗？

faq.question: 预览会显示多少行？
faq.answer: 为了保持页面流畅，预览只渲染前 100 行。显示的行数和 CSV 导出仍然覆盖数组中的每一条记录。

faq.question: 可以把表格下载成 CSV 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。CSV 使用带 BOM 的 UTF-8 编码，Excel 能正确识别带重音和非拉丁字符的内容；包含逗号、引号或换行的值会被加引号并转义。

faq.question: 可以转换很大的 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 页面没有设置固定的行数上限，但全部处理都在浏览器中完成。非常大的数组取决于设备内存，解析和渲染会更慢。

faq.question: 这个页面会生成 HTML 代码吗？
faq.answer: 不会。本页面用于把 JSON 记录预览为表格并导出 CSV。需要可复制的表格代码或可下载的 .html 文件时，请使用“JSON 转 HTML 表格”页面。

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 本页面在你的浏览器中解析 JSON 并生成表格，不需要上传到转换服务器。仍然建议不要在任何浏览器工具中输入密码、API 密钥、访问令牌或其他高度敏感的信息。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的 JSON 转表格转换器吗？
faq.answer: 是的。你可以粘贴或打开 JSON、预览表格并下载 CSV，无需注册账号。

article.title: 如何把 JSON 转成表格
article.content:
什么是 JSON 转表格转换器？

JSON 转表格转换器把结构化的 JSON 记录铺成行和列，方便人眼阅读。最适合的数据是对象数组：每个对象是一条记录，每个属性是一列。

开发者在查看接口响应、数据库导出、日志文件或配置快照时经常用到这个视图。把 200 条记录读成表格，通常比滚动原始 JSON 文本快得多；行数和列数也能让你一眼确认整个数组是否被完整读取。

支持的 JSON 结构

支持的输入是顶层对象数组：

[{"name":"Alice","age":30},{"name":"Bob","age":25}]

数组里的每一项都必须是对象。["a","b"] 这样的字符串数组、数字数组、数组的数组都无法变成行和列，会被直接报错。如果数据被包在 {"results":[...]} 这样的对象里，请粘贴内层的数组。

如何把 JSON 转成表格

  1. 输入 JSON：把对象数组粘贴进编辑器，或打开 .json 文件。
  2. 看统计数字：先看识别到的行数和列数，确认整个数组都解析成功。
  3. 检查表头：确认需要的字段都成了列，并且数值对齐。
  4. 处理嵌套：需要把嵌套属性变成独立列时启用展平。
  5. 导出：下载 CSV，然后在 Excel、Google Sheets 或其他电子表格里继续处理。

自动识别列与缺失值

真实数据很少每条记录的键都完全一致：用户列表里手机号可能是可选的，订单列表里只有部分行有退款字段。转换器会从每一个对象里收集键，按首次出现的顺序组成列。

某条记录缺少某个字段时，单元格留空。行的对齐关系不会错，但如果原始数据里可选字段很多，表格就会变得很宽，空单元格也会变多。

展平嵌套 JSON

扁平表格最适合每个单元格都是字符串、数字、布尔或 null 这类标量值的情况。嵌套对象放不进一个单元格，所以可选的展平模式会把路径改写成点号列：

{"user":{"name":"Alice"},"address":{"city":"New York"}}

会变成 user.name、address.city 这样的列。嵌套数组更麻烦：它可能包含多个值或多个对象，没有唯一合适的二维形态。不展平时，对象和数组值会以一个单元格里的紧凑 JSON 文本显示。

表格预览、CSV 与 HTML 输出

这三种输出解决的是不同问题，开始前先选对：

  • 表格预览：在浏览器里快速阅读和检查数据。
  • CSV：数据要继续进入 Excel、Google Sheets、数据库导入或报表流程时使用。
  • HTML 表格：结果要显示在网页上，或粘贴进 CMS、文档编辑器时使用。
  • 原始 JSON：需要保留嵌套结构、精确类型或机器间交换时保留原格式。

表格预览的边界

预览是根据你的输入生成的静态视图，不提供排序、筛选、分页、编辑或列选择，也没有电子表格式的工具栏。为了保持页面流畅，预览只渲染前 100 行；显示的行数和 CSV 导出仍然覆盖每一条记录。

如果需要排序、筛选、做图表或编辑数据，请下载 CSV 后在电子表格里继续。如果需要可嵌入网页的代码，请使用“JSON 转 HTML 表格”页面。

浏览器本地处理与隐私

这个工具在你的浏览器中解析 JSON 并生成表格，而不是把输入上传到远程转换服务。这对内部数据集和开发数据很方便，但并不等于绝对安全。不要在任何在线工具中输入凭证、访问令牌、个人信息或机密生产数据。
